note: Aetherytes the first-visit rule of the unlock index (feature plan v6 K1) cannot place: no objective of the main scenario stands within 40 yalms of them. Keys are Aetheryte sheet row ids; quests are the Quest sheet row ids that first take a character there (several when paths differ). A curated entry replaces whatever the rule inferred for that aetheryte, and the Unlocks section shows it as stated rather than likely. Every entry needs the aetheryte's name, a note and an evidence URL; notes are original wording, never wiki sentences. Aetherytes still missing are listed in UnlockLinkReaderTests.NotYetCurated.
